title: Days of the Week
label: ch:ta-days-of-the-week
canDo: I can name the seven weekdays, take each apart as planet plus கிழமை, and say which are Tamil's own words and which arrived from Sanskrit.

payoff.summary: Complete TA-C10-checkpoint, the chapter's closing checkpoint: run the week from thiṅgaḷ to ñāyiṟu with kizhamai, sort the four native planet-words from the three Sanskrit ones, tell ந from ன and name ற, find ◌ா in நான், then write ந, ன, ற and நா from sound.
payoff.note: TA-C10-checkpoint (sequence 535, TA-PATH-016 order 1, after TA-S114-vowel-sign-aa and before chapter 11's first lesson) assesses all six atoms the chapter introduces (6/6). It is the payoff because four of them, ற (TA-S05-rra, 525), ந, ன and ற for நன்றி (TA-W04-vowel-signs-nandri, 530) and ◌ா (TA-S114-vowel-sign-aa, 531), are taught after the spoken lesson TA-C10-vaara-kizhamai (520), which could honestly assess only its own two atoms (2/6); that lesson stays as the chapter's spoken lesson. The script lessons sit on the earlier TA-PATH-003 and TA-PATH-100 segments, so the checkpoint comes after all of them on the sequence and on the path.
